item: rollup affordability verdict reads a cgroup memory limit (R302)
summary: The rollup build's start check took psutil's machine-wide available memory, so inside a container or service memory limit it never declined (measured: 2,048 MB cgroup, 15,542 MB reported, a 3,904 MB build started). _readings now takes the smaller of the machine figure and the cgroup's limit less usage plus reclaimable inactive_file (src/config/cgroup_memory.py, reusing src/osm/reader.cgroup_reading's v1/v2 nested walk), and every verdict says which figure it used in available_from (cgroup limit / machine / machine with an unreadable limit). Unreadable is no figure, never 0. memory_budget, machine_floor and memguard still read the host figure: follow-ups for their lanes.
